verdict.rationale: The pack contains SDK release notes, a 'latest' path for SDK reference docs, and Beta/Alpha/experimental labels on some features. None of this documents API versioning guarantees or a deprecation policy, so it is adjacent at best. The axis applies to a developer platform like Modal, but there is no evidence of a documented deprecation policy or versioned-API commitments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
